desc: Research the intended algorithm for the AtCoder problem "Grid and Path" (likely AGC). The intended solution uses a segment tree over the larger dimension with small matrices.
Understand that the matrix multiplication approach is too slow in Python due to O(W^2 log H) per update.

Implement a solution using a Fenwick tree (BIT) on the diagonals: each diagonal d has a bidiagonal matrix (or upper/lower bidiagonal depending on d), and we can combine O(log N) such matrices in O(W log N) time per update. Since W ≤ 447, this should be fast enough in Python.
Test the implementation with the provided sample inputs.
Optimize further if needed (e.g., precompute prefix products for faster matrix-vector multiplication, use PyPy for speed).
